_comment: Least-privilege inline policy for the AMPLIFY BUILD role (SECRETS-MIGRATION.md step 4).
The build's SSM-pull loop (amplify.yml preBuild) reads exactly the 9 parameters listed
below. Scoping the build role to just these — instead of a wildcard on /matt-grant/* —
keeps the four RUNTIME-ONLY secrets (CRON_SECRET, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, WINRED_WEBHOOK_SECRET,
UNSUB_SECRET) out of the build blast radius, which is the whole point of the migration.
The runtime SSR compute role keeps its separate /matt-grant/* read (setup-aws.sh step 6).
Replace ACCOUNT_ID with the AWS account and KMS_KEY_ARN with the CMK used for SecureStrings
(or drop the KMS statement if all 9 params are plain String type). Region assumed us-east-1.
